others.name: Veg House Holdings Inc.
others.role: Parent company and only current stockholder

what: Little West makes and sells cold-pressed juices and other health-focused drinks from its base in California.
proceeds: It plans to split the net proceeds equally, 20% each, across growing distribution, marketing, working capital, hiring staff, and general corporate purposes. It says it has broad freedom in how it uses the money.
risks: Little West is a holding company, so it depends on cash and payments from its subsidiaries to cover its costs and pay any dividends.
Produce and other raw materials may become scarce or costly because of weather, disasters and competition for supply, which could cut sales and raise costs.
It relies on a few outside partners, mainly for produce, and has no formal contracts requiring suppliers to provide what it needs.
risks_note: The first 3 risk factors, summarised by AI.
